title: Nimboran language - Wikipedia
text: December 26, 2024 - Nimboran (Nambrong, Namblong, Namlong) is a Papuan language of Nimboran District, Jayapura Regency, Indonesia spoken by mostly older adults. Younger generations have shifted to Papuan Malay.

title: Mlap language - Wikipedia
text: November 25, 2025 - Mlap, or Kwansu (obsolete), is a Papuan language of Indonesia. It is spoken just to the west of Lake Sentani.

title: Mlap Language (KJA) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map, Endangered Level & Official Use | Ethnologue Free
text: Mlap is an endangered indigenous language of Indonesia. It belongs to the Nimboran language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by the elderly only. It is not known to be taught in schools.
